about_the_game:
Destructive Yacht-Inspired Deck-Building Roguelike

Roll an avalanche of dice to craft classic Yacht hands and trigger explosive synergies that send your score through the roof!

Players must land as many hands as possible within a limited number of rolls each stage, stacking up points to beat the target score. Spend your hard-earned coins on powerful items to turbocharge your progress and break every limit.

  • Classic Yacht Hands
    Full House, Straight, Yacht… instantly familiar combos that reward you in a flash.

  • Deck-Building & Shop
    Customize your strategy: choose the right items after each stage to tailor your deck.

  • Roguelike Progression
    Target scores climb with every level—retry endlessly and chase your personal best.

  • Synergistic Power
    Fuse items and rare cards for skyrocketing score multipliers.

Easy to pick up, impossible to put down: the perfect blend of thrilling chance and deep strategy. Hear the dice clatter and watch your numbers explode—experience the ultimate numerical rush!

【About This Demo】 This demo version allows you to enjoy nearly the same core gameplay as the full version up to stage 20. (The full version will allow play beyond stage 20)

The full version will include the following features:

  • More items

  • Boss stages and bonus stages

  • Endless mode with unlimited gameplay
